Atrium Health, one of the nation’s most comprehensive public, not-for-profit healthcare systems, is actively recruiting an experienced Critical Care Nurse Practitioner (NP) or Physician Assistant (PA) to join Atrium Health Pineville. This rapidly growing 394-bed community hospital is located in Pineville, NC, just 14 miles south of Charlotte near the South Carolina border.

This role is part of a highly skilled critical care team dedicated to delivering world-class, comprehensive care to critically ill and injured patients across multiple specialty intensive care units.

Key Responsibilities

• Provide daily management and documentation of complex, critically ill medical and surgical patients
• Deliver care across multiple specialty ICUs, including:
• Cardiac Medical ICU
• Cardiothoracic Surgical ICU
• Medical ICU
• Surgical ICU
• Admit and manage patients directly from the operating room and interventional cardiac lab
• Manage post-operative cardiac surgery patients and hemodynamically complex cases
• Collaborate closely with intensivists and interdisciplinary care teams
• Utilize and manage mechanical circulatory support devices (e.g., IABP, Impella)
• Perform procedures such as central venous and arterial line placement (preferred)

• Graduate of an accredited Acute Care Nurse Practitioner (ACNP) or Physician Assistant (PA) program

• Master’s or Doctorate in Nursing Practice

• Certification from the National Commission on Certification of Physician Assistants (NCCPA)
• Active North Carolina license

Preferred:

• Postgraduate ICU fellowship
• Prior ICU experience as an NP or PA

• Experience with invasive procedures (central lines, arterial lines)

Position Summary

The Cardiac ICU Advanced Practice Provider (APP)—Nurse Practitioner (NP) or Physician Assistant (PA)—will be an integral member of a high-acuity multidisciplinary team managing critically ill patients with advanced cardiac conditions. The APP will provide comprehensive care for patients with cardiogenic shock, advanced heart failure, post–myocardial infarction complications, and those requiring temporary mechanical circulatory support (MCS), including ECMO, Impella, and IABP.

This role involves direct patient management, procedural skills, and close collaboration with cardiology, cardiac surgery, critical care, and ancillary services. The APP will also play a key role in education, coordination, and working with residents rotating through the cardiac ICU.

Key Responsibilities

• Perform comprehensive assessment, diagnosis, and management of critically ill cardiac patients.
• Manage patients with acute decompensated heart failure, cardiogenic shock, and post-MI complications.
• Manage temporary mechanical circulatory support devices including ECMO, Impella, IABP, and ventricular assist devices under established protocols.
• Collaborate closely with attending cardiologists, intensivists, cardiac surgeons, and the broader care team to optimize patient outcomes.
• Provide ongoing monitoring, titration, and weaning of vasoactive medications, inotropes, and mechanical support devices.
• Coordinate patient transitions between levels of care, including step-down and transfer to tertiary facilities when necessary.
• Work collaboratively with nursing staff, pharmacists, physical therapists, nutritionists, and other team members.
• Participate in quality improvement initiatives, protocol development, and research activities related to cardiac critical care.

Qualifications

• Education:
• Master's degree in nursing (MSN) or Physician Assistant Studies (MPAS) required.
• Licensure & Certification:
• Active, unrestricted NP or PA license in NC.
• National certification (ACNP, AGACNP, or NCCPA certification required).
• Current BLS and ACLS certification.
• Critical care or cardiac certification (CCRN, CSC, or equivalent) preferred.
• Experience:
• Minimum 2–3 years of experience in cardiac critical care, CVICU, or related specialty preferred.
• Proficiency with ECMO, Impella, IABP, and advanced hemodynamic monitoring strongly desired.
• Prior experience in academic or teaching hospital settings is a plus.

Skills & Competencies

• Advanced clinical assessment and critical thinking skills.
• Strong proficiency in hemodynamic interpretation and mechanical support management.
• Effective interdisciplinary communication and teamwork.
• Commitment to evidence-based practice and continuous learning.
• Ability to work in a fast-paced, high-acuity environment with a focus on precision and collaboration.

Why Join Advocate Health CICU

• Work at a leading cardiac critical care center with one of the region’s highest volumes of mechanical circulatory support.
• Collaborate with renowned cardiologists, cardiac surgeons, and intensivists in a cutting-edge environment.
• Access ongoing professional development, advanced procedure training, and research opportunities.

jobs.title: Advanced Practice Provider (PA/NP) - Intensivists
jobs.summary: Advanced Practice Provider (PA/NP) - Intensivists at UNC Rex Hospital. Notable: nights.
jobs.description:
Your passion belongs at UNC Health. Join more than 56,000 teammates working together to improve the health and well-being of the communities we serve across North Carolina.

Summary:
An Advanced Practice Provider functions as part of the interdisciplinary healthcare team in accordance with privileges approved by the credentialing committee to provide high quality, cost effective care to patients within the APPs scope of practice in collaboration with a supervising physician. The APP reflects the mission, vision, and values of the organization, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and other regulatory and accreditation standards.

Responsibilities:
1. Clinical- Obtains relevant health and medical history, performs thorough physical assessment, reviews and interprets pertinent diagnostic tests/results. Develops appropriate differential diagnoses. Develops and implements treatment plans including prescribing/ordering of appropriate evidence-based pharmacological agents consistent with departmental guidelines and privileging, and schedules appropriate follow-up management. Actively incorporates evidence-based hospital initiatives to improve patient care. Conducts preventive health screening based on age, history and patient needs. Maintains clear comprehensive yet concise records of all aspects of patient care. Maintains essential knowledge of general disease and pathologic processes. Maintains extensive knowledge of their specialty literature including awareness of developing areas. Consistently derives correct diagnoses through synthesis of clinical data and proper selection and interpretation of diagnostic studies. Develops comprehensive differential diagnoses for patients. Revises the plan of care to meet the changing needs of the patient. Prioritizes work and assists staff to provide prompt and efficient client flow. Consistently maintains high productivity according to identified standards. Leads/participates in projects to improve productivity. Appropriately performs medical procedures consistent with departmental guidelines, privileging, and clinical roles/responsibilities.
2. Education- Appropriately and professionally educates clients and/or families regarding medical condition, treatment, and follow-up. Collaborates with clinicians, staff, and students to promote continuity and patient/family centered care. Develops educational materials based on learning needs of clinicians, staff, and students. Provide education/instruction to physicians, housestaff, nursing, ancillaries and/or students. Actively recognizes and participates in identification and achievement of self-learning needs. Attends education programs based on identified learning needs.
3. Leadership- Provides instruction to physicians, housestaff, nursing, ancillaries and/or students including but not limited to precepting, shadowing, lectures, training classes, CE, rounds, morning report, and or staff meetings. Participates in community/network outreach programs. Develops/leads community/network outreach programs. Demonstrates both an understanding of the contexts and system in which healthcare is provided and the ability to apply this knowledge to improve and optimize health care delivery. Leads/participates in systems improvements.
4. Professional- Interacts with patients and families in a respectful, courteous and timely fashion using appropriate communication for the patient and situation. Interacts collaboratively with coworkers, other team members and staff in a respectful, courteous, and timely fashion appropriate to patient care needs and situations. Responds quickly to meet customer needs and resolve problems. Accepts responsibility for outcomes of one?s work. Shares responsibility for overall workload with team members.
5. Quality/Research- Engages in daily continuous quality improvement by identifying and implementing processes for improvement. Consults with management in assessment, problem-solving, decision-making, and evaluating clinical/system issues and models of care. Leads interdisciplinary teams to provide integrated delivery of patient care services. Initiates and revises protocol(s) or guideline(s) to reflect evidence-based changes in care management Works to influence policy-making bodies to improve patient care. Develops new clinical programs or services within the department/unit/clinic to improve patient care.

Other Information

Other information:
Education Requirements:
● Completion of an accredited graduate-level Advanced Practice Provider (APRN or PA) program.
Licensure/Certification Requirements:
● Licensed as an Advanced Practice Provider (i.e., Nurse Practitioner, Physician Assistant, Clinical Pharmacist Practitioner, Certified Nurse Midwife, Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetist) in the state of North Carolina.
● Board certification if required by the Department. DEA.
Professional Experience Requirements:
● No prior experience required.
Knowledge/Skills/and Abilities Requirements:
● Demonstrated clinical competency.
● Effective leadership skills. Strong interpersonal skills.
● Ability to work independently and collaboratively.
● Demonstrated written and verbal communication and strong analytical skills.
● Effective interaction to ensure the successful care of patients in the clinical setting.
● Documentation in the medical record to substantiate accurate billing.

jobs.location_text: 1900 S Hawthorne Road, Suite 201, Winston-Salem, North Carolina
jobs.summary: Inpatient Surgical Urology Advanced Practice Provider at Novant Health Presbyterian Medical Center.
jobs.description:
What We Offer

Are you looking to join a collaborative team where exceptional care and service come together—every dimension, every time?

Novant Health Medical Group is seeking a compassionate and skilled Surgical Advanced Practice Provider (APP) to join our growing urology team in Winston-Salem, NC.

In this role, you will deliver comprehensive care to urologic patients in the acute care setting at Novant Health Forsyth Medical Center. Key responsibilities include supporting inpatient surgical services, performing consults, and rounding on patients with urologic conditions. This position is well suited for a motivated clinician who is passionate about managing and advancing care for patients with complex urologic needs.

The ideal candidate is patient-centered, adaptable, and dependable, with the ability to thrive in a collaborative, team-oriented environment. The typical schedule is 7-on/7-off rotation days only. Prior experience in urology and surgical assisting is preferred. RNFA certification is required for nurse practitioner applicants.

Our multidisciplinary team of surgeons, nurse practitioners, and physician assistants works closely to deliver exceptional outcomes for both operative and non-operative patients. As an APP, you will practice under physician supervision while exercising a high level of clinical judgment across a broad scope of responsibilities.

Why Winston-Salem?

Winston-Salem offers a vibrant blend of culture, recreation, and accessibility. The region features minor league baseball, collegiate athletics, local wineries, and a thriving arts scene including theater and ballet. Conveniently located, it’s within two hours of Charlotte, the Blue Ridge Mountains, and the Research Triangle (Raleigh, Durham, Chapel Hill), with easy access to beaches and scenic destinations like Smith Mountain Lake. Nearby international airports in Greensboro and Charlotte make travel simple.

Novant Health Benefits:

• Medical group employment
• Comprehensive medical and retirement benefits
• CME allowance
• Epic electronic health record system
• Malpractice coverage
• Strong emphasis on work-life balance

About Novant Health Medical Group:

• One of the largest medical groups in the nation
• Dedicated resiliency and wellness programs to help prevent burnout
• ODYSSEY onboarding program designed to support new physicians and APPs
• Active APP Council focused on professional development, engagement, and clinical excellence
• A nationally recognized, nonprofit, community-based health system
• Physician-led organization with strong clinical leadership at every level

What It Means to Join Novant Health:

Novant Health is an integrated network of clinics, outpatient centers, and hospitals focused on delivering seamless, high-quality care. With more than 1,900 physicians and 36,000 team members across 800+ locations, we serve millions of patients annually while remaining deeply committed to our communities.

We are proud to be recognized as one of the best employers in North Carolina and nationally for workplace diversity and inclusion. Our commitment to community impact is reflected in over $1.5 billion in annual community benefit and ongoing support for local health and human service organizations.

At Novant Health, diversity and inclusion are core to who we are. We believe that embracing the unique strengths of every team member allows us to provide remarkable care to our patients, families, and communities. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds to apply.

Join us, and let’s transform healthcare together.

#MakeHealthcareRemarkable #JoinTeamAubergine #NHMGAPPs

What You'll Do

It is the responsibility of every Novant Health team member to deliver the most remarkable patient experience in every dimension, every time.

• Our team members are part of an environment that fosters team work, team member engagement and community involvement.
• The successful team member has a commitment to leveraging diversity and inclusion in support of quality care.
• All Novant Health team members are responsible for fostering a safe patient environment driven by the principles of "First Do No Harm".

What We're Looking For

Education: Master's Degree required. Either a graduate of an NCCPA accredited physician assistant program, or NP or post Master’s NP program required.

Experience: One year of experience in urology preferred.

Licensure/Certification/Registration: Current PA or NP license in appropriate state required. NCCPA or registry with state nursing board, ACLS, DEA registry required. RNFA certification required for NP's applicants

Additional Skills Required: Ability to successfully complete generic and depart-specific skills validation and competency testing; Thorough knowledge of diagnosis, and pharmacology; Thorough skill in physical assessment and management of chronic illness; Communication skills, both verbal and written; general computer knowledge is preferred; ability to work independently, yet in collaboration when necessary. Ability to use problem-solving, decision making, creative and communication skills. Dedicated to patient rehabilitation and self-care.

jobs.location_text: 211 Friday Center Drive, Chapel Hill, NC
jobs.summary: Advanced Practice Provider (NP/PA) - SOM Amb Care-APCF-Neurology at UNC Medical Center. Setting: mixed settings.
jobs.description:
Become part of an inclusive organization with over 40,000 teammates, whose mission is to improve the health and well-being of the unique communities we serve.

As a vital member of the Neuro-Oncology Division within the Department of Neurology, the Nurse Practitioner works within an interdisciplinary team to deliver high-quality, cost-effective care. Operating under the oversight of a supervising physician and in alignment with committee-approved privileges, the APP provides specialized patient management within their full scope of practice.

Summary:
A Nurse Practitioner functions as part of the interdisciplinary healthcare team in accordance with privileges approved by the credentialing committee to provide high quality, cost effective care to patients within the APPs scope of practice in collaboration with a supervising physician. The APP reflects the mission, vision, and values of the organization, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and other regulatory and accreditation standards.

Responsibilities:
1. Clinical- Obtains relevant health and medical history, performs thorough physical assessment, reviews and interprets pertinent diagnostic tests/results. Develops appropriate differential diagnoses. Develops and implements treatment plans including prescribing/ordering of appropriate evidence-based pharmacological agents consistent with departmental guidelines and privileging, and schedules appropriate follow-up management. Actively incorporates evidence-based hospital initiatives to improve patient care. Conducts preventive health screening based on age, history and patient needs. Maintains clear comprehensive yet concise records of all aspects of patient care. Maintains essential knowledge of general disease and pathologic processes. Maintains extensive knowledge of their specialty literature including awareness of developing areas. Consistently derives correct diagnoses through synthesis of clinical data and proper selection and interpretation of diagnostic studies. Develops comprehensive differential diagnoses for patients. Revises the plan of care to meet the changing needs of the patient. Prioritizes work and assists staff to provide prompt and efficient client flow. Consistently maintains high productivity according to identified standards. Leads/participates in projects to improve productivity. Appropriately performs medical procedures consistent with departmental guidelines, privileging, and clinical roles/responsibilities.
2. Education- Appropriately and professionally educates clients and/or families regarding medical condition, treatment, and follow-up. Collaborates with clinicians, staff, and students to promote continuity and patient/family centered care. Develops educational materials based on learning needs of clinicians, staff, and students. Provide education/instruction to physicians, housestaff, nursing, ancillaries and/or students. Actively recognizes and participates in identification and achievement of self-learning needs. Attends education programs based on identified learning needs.
3. Leadership- Provides instruction to physicians, housestaff, nursing, ancillaries and/or students including but not limited to precepting, shadowing, lectures, training classes, CE, rounds, morning report, and or staff meetings. Participates in community/network outreach programs. Develops/leads community/network outreach programs. Demonstrates both an understanding of the contexts and system in which healthcare is provided and the ability to apply this knowledge to improve and optimize health care delivery. Leads/participates in systems improvements.
4. Professional- Interacts with patients and families in a respectful, courteous and timely fashion using appropriate communication for the patient and situation. Interacts collaboratively with coworkers, other team members and staff in a respectful, courteous, and timely fashion appropriate to patient care needs and situations. Responds quickly to meet customer needs and resolve problems. Accepts responsibility for outcomes of one?s work. Shares responsibility for overall workload with team members.
5. Quality/Research- Engages in daily continuous quality improvement by identifying and implementing processes for improvement. Consults with management in assessment, problem-solving, decision-making, and evaluating clinical/system issues and models of care. Leads interdisciplinary teams to provide integrated delivery of patient care services. Initiates and revises protocol(s) or guideline(s) to reflect evidence-based changes in care management Works to influence policy-making bodies to improve patient care. Develops new clinical programs or services within the department/unit/clinic to improve patient care.

Other Information

Other information:
Education Requirements:
● Completion of an accredited graduate-level Advanced Practice Provider (APRN or PA) program.
Licensure/Certification Requirements:
● Licensed as an Advanced Practice Provider (i.e., Nurse Practitioner, Physician Assistant, Clinical Pharmacist Practitioner, Certified Nurse Midwife, Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetist) in the state of North Carolina.
● Board certification if required by the Department. DEA.
Professional Experience Requirements:
● No prior experience required.
Knowledge/Skills/and Abilities Requirements:
● Demonstrated clinical competency.
● Effective leadership skills. Strong interpersonal skills.
● Ability to work independently and collaboratively.
● Demonstrated written and verbal communication and strong analytical skills.
● Effective interaction to ensure the successful care of patients in the clinical setting.
● Documentation in the medical record to substantiate accurate billing.

jobs.title: Hybrid PCP/Virtual Care Weight Management APP
jobs.summary: Hybrid PCP/Virtual Care Weight Management APP at Duke Raleigh Hospital.
jobs.description:
Duke Primary Care (DPC) is seeking an Advanced Practice Provider (APP) to serve in a combined role both as a Primary Care Provider (PCP), and as a member of the Virtual Care Team’s Virtual Weight Management Clinic (VWMC).

PCPs are clinicians responsible for addressing the personal health care needs of patients in the ambulatory setting. DPC PCPs will develop long-term, patient-centered relationships with the goal of achieving outstanding health outcomes and exceptional patient experience. APPs will have training in family medicine or internal medicine & pediatrics (IM-Peds) and will be expected to work in a multidisciplinary team-based environment. PCPs work at one of DPC’s primary care locations around the Triangle region of central North Carolina.

Members of DPC’s Virtual Care Team (VCT) are clinicians responsible for managing patient needs through video visits, and this role will primarily focus on Obesity Management. Providers should have a strong understanding of Obesity Pathophysiology and comprehensive treatment approaches and have a current certification in Obesity Medicine by American Board of Obesity Medicine (ABOM). APPs will provide comprehensive Obesity care (assessment, diagnosis, treatment through behavioral/lifestyle therapy/pharmacotherapy) for adult patients and collaborate with a multidisciplinary team of Registered Dieticians, Health Coach and Behavioral Therapist to optimize comprehensive care.

The virtual portion of this role is primarily dedicated to Weight Management, with the flexibility to provide care for acute illnesses via video visits when weight management appointments are not fully utilized.

If it's possible, you will find it at Atrium Health—the leading community-focused academic healthcare system serving North Carolina, South Carolina and Georgia. We invite experienced APPs to discover all that we can do when we bring healing hearts, inquisitive minds and visionaries together.

Sanger Heart & Vascular Institute's Interventional and Structural Heart Program is seeking a Full-time advanced practice provider (APP) to join our growing team.

This position is occupied by board certified physician assistants and/or acute care nurse practitioners trained and proficient in providing cardiac services.

*Sign-On Bonus Eligible*

The APP in this position will function at the top of their license in the inpatient hospital and outpatient clinic-based setting in collaboration with a supervising physician and other members of a multidisciplinary team.

This role will be an integral component of a high functioning multidisciplinary team of providers including cardiology APPs, interventional cardiologists, cardiothoracic surgeons, and imaging cardiologists.

The APP is responsible for inpatient daily rounds, consultations, admissions, and discharges, along with clinic appointments.

The APP is competent inpatient examinations, medication management, and ordering laboratory/radiologic testing and interpretation of results, including ECGs.

Position Responsibilities

This is a medical cardiology role. APP is not expected to perform procedures but will manage patients pre and post procedurally.

APP is expected to perform admission, rounding, consult and discharge notes on patients in the inpatient and ED setting, along with same day procedure setting. APP is also expected to adequately perform clinic visits in the outpatient setting.

Full time day shift, 40-hour work week, 4 x 10-hour shifts. No call or night shift.

Setting that they will be working – Hybrid (inpatient/outpatient). APP is expected to see 14 outpatients on a full day of clinic.

Opportunity to participate in committees, teaching – Opportunities to participate in committees, especially those around improving care for individual service line. APP is expected to participate in education of APP fellows, MD students, residents, or in onboarding of new APPs.

Work independently and work well with a team. He or she will be responsible for the management of patients undergoing catheter-based interventions for coronary artery disease and valvular heart disease, along with providing general cardiology care and heart failure management in an inpatient and outpatient setting.

Position Requirements:

Graduation from an accredited NP or PA program. Current license to practice as a NP or PA in North Carolina. Current prescriptive privileges and DEA license required. BLS/ACLS Certified.

Nurse practitioners with Master's degree of Doctorate of Nursing Practice. ACNP, AGACNP required based on population served.

Nurse practitioners are required to have Acute Care Certification

Physician Assistants with certification from the National Commission on Certification of Physician Assistants required.

Ideal Candidate Qualities:

1+ years of experience as a provider required; experience in Cardiology

Highly motivated with superb communication and organizational skills with a commitment to provide quality care to the patients we serve in the Greater Charlotte community

About the Practice/Facility

Sanger Heart & Vascular Institute is one of the Southeast's largest cardiac and vascular programs providing the highest quality care available to patients with cardiovascular disease throughout North and South Carolina. Sanger employs over 110 physicians and 140 APPs in a network of over 25 locations to provide the highest quality care available to patients with cardiovascular disease.

Sanger has more than 50 years of experience in providing comprehensive acute and chronic cardiovascular services, including the region's only heart transplant center and pediatric heart surgery program.

When you join Atrium Health, you will be welcomed into a culture that celebrates and respects the contributions a team can make together. Practice where your voice is valued, your passion for advancing medicine is rewarded, and you get the resources and support you need to thrive personally and professionally. In our nationally-renowned integrated health system, you can work alongside the most advanced minds in medicine to improve medicine, and redefine care for all.

Essential Functions

• Performs initial and periodic medical history, physical examinations, and daily assessments.
• Records findings of examinations, assessments and plan of care.
• Performs minor office-based medical and/or surgical procedures.
• Writes appropriate prescriptions and administers medications.
• Orders and interprets daily laboratory and radiology examinations.
• Determines treatment plan for patient.
• Documents all patient encounters, records observations, interventions, and actions in a medically appropriate manner on the patient's medical record.
• Acts as a patient advocate for the population served.
• Attends, participates and contributes to group/practice meetings and development of policies and procedures when requested.

Physical Requirements
Work requires walking, standing, sitting, lifting, reaching, bending, stooping, pushing and pulling. Job Description

If it's possible, you will find it at Atrium Health—the leading community-focused academic healthcare system serving North Carolina, South Carolina and Georgia. We invite experienced APPs to discover all that we can do when we bring healing hearts, inquisitive minds and visionaries together.

Sanger Heart & Vascular Institute's Interventional and Structural Heart Program is seeking a Full-time advanced practice provider (APP) to join our growing team at Atrium Health Cabarrus.

• This position is occupied by board certified physician assistants and/or acute care nurse practitioners trained and proficient in providing cardiac services.
• The APP in this position will function at the top of their license in the inpatient hospital and outpatient clinic-based setting in collaboration with a supervising physician and other members of a multidisciplinary team.
• This role will be an integral component of a high functioning multidisciplinary team of providers including cardiology APPs, interventional cardiologists, cardiothoracic surgeons, and imaging cardiologists.
• The APP is responsible for inpatient daily rounds, consultations, admissions, and discharges, along with clinic appointments.
• The APP is competent inpatient examinations, medication management, and ordering laboratory/radiologic testing and interpretation of results, including ECGs.

Position Responsibilities

• This is a medical cardiology role. APP is not expected to perform procedures but will manage patients pre and post procedurally. Cabarrus is a STEMI center and as a part of the Structural Heart Program procedures such as TAVRs, PFO closures, and LAA closures are performed.
• APP is expected to perform admission, rounding, consult and discharge notes on patients in the inpatient and ED setting, along with same day procedure setting. APP is also expected to adequately perform clinic visits in the outpatient setting.
• Full time day shift, 40-hour work week, 4 x 10-hour shifts. No call or night shift.
• Setting that they will be working – Hybrid (inpatient/outpatient). APP is expected to see 14 outpatients on a full day of clinic.
• Opportunity to participate in committees, teaching – Opportunities to participate in committees, especially those around improving care for individual service line. APP is expected to participate in education of APP fellows, MD students, residents, or in onboarding of new APPs.
• Interventional Team – There are currently 3 APPs and 4 MDs on the team at Cabarrus. The applicant is expected to learn to cross cover at CMC as part of the broader Interventional program, totaling 14 APPs and 14 MDs.
• Work independently and work well with a team. He or she will be responsible for the management of patients undergoing catheter-based interventions for coronary artery disease and valvular heart disease, along with providing general cardiology care and heart failure management in an inpatient and outpatient setting.

Position Requirements:

• Graduation from an accredited NP or PA program. Current license to practice as a NP or PA in North Carolina. Current prescriptive privileges and DEA license required. BLS/ACLS Certified.
• Nurse practitioners with Master's degree of Doctorate of Nursing Practice. ACNP, AGACNP required based on population served.
• Nurse practitioners are required to have Acute Care Certification
• Physician Assistants with certification from the National Commission on Certification of Physician Assistants required.

Ideal Candidate Qualities:

• 1+ years of experience as a provider required; experience in Cardiology
• Highly motivated with superb communication and organizational skills with a commitment to provide quality care to the patients we serve in the Greater Charlotte community

Sanger Heart & Vascular Institute is one of the Southeast's largest cardiac and vascular programs providing the highest quality care available to patients with cardiovascular disease throughout North and South Carolina. Sanger employs over 110 physicians and 140 APPs in a network of over 25 locations to provide the highest quality care available to patients with cardiovascular disease.

Sanger has more than 50 years of experience in providing comprehensive acute and chronic cardiovascular services, including the region's only heart transplant center and pediatric heart surgery program.

Atrium Health Cabarrus is a regional 457-bed, not-for-profit hospital in Concord, NC. More than 4,200 hospital employees provide services through an extensive inpatient and outpatient network, including Jeff Gordon Children's Hospital, Hayes Family Center and Batte Cancer Center, part of Atrium Health's Levine Cancer Institute.

jobs.description:
Become part of an inclusive organization with over 40,000 teammates, whose mission is to improve the health and well-being of the unique communities we serve.

Summary:
An Advanced Practice Provider functions as part of the interdisciplinary healthcare team in accordance with privileges approved by the credentialing committee to provide high quality, cost effective care to patients within the APPs scope of practice in collaboration with a supervising physician. The APP reflects the mission, vision, and values of the organization, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and other regulatory and accreditation standards.

Responsibilities:
1. Clinical- Obtains relevant health and medical history, performs thorough physical assessment, reviews and interprets pertinent diagnostic tests/results. Develops appropriate differential diagnoses. Develops and implements treatment plans including prescribing/ordering of appropriate evidence-based pharmacological agents consistent with departmental guidelines and privileging, and schedules appropriate follow-up management. Actively incorporates evidence-based hospital initiatives to improve patient care. Conducts preventive health screening based on age, history and patient needs. Maintains clear comprehensive yet concise records of all aspects of patient care. Maintains essential knowledge of general disease and pathologic processes. Maintains extensive knowledge of their specialty literature including awareness of developing areas. Consistently derives correct diagnoses through synthesis of clinical data and proper selection and interpretation of diagnostic studies. Develops comprehensive differential diagnoses for patients. Revises the plan of care to meet the changing needs of the patient. Prioritizes work and assists staff to provide prompt and efficient client flow. Consistently maintains high productivity according to identified standards. Leads/participates in projects to improve productivity. Appropriately performs medical procedures consistent with departmental guidelines, privileging, and clinical roles/responsibilities.
2. Education- Appropriately and professionally educates clients and/or families regarding medical condition, treatment, and follow-up. Collaborates with clinicians, staff, and students to promote continuity and patient/family centered care. Develops educational materials based on learning needs of clinicians, staff, and students. Provide education/instruction to physicians, housestaff, nursing, ancillaries and/or students. Actively recognizes and participates in identification and achievement of self-learning needs. Attends education programs based on identified learning needs.
3. Leadership- Provides instruction to physicians, housestaff, nursing, ancillaries and/or students including but not limited to precepting, shadowing, lectures, training classes, CE, rounds, morning report, and or staff meetings. Participates in community/network outreach programs. Develops/leads community/network outreach programs. Demonstrates both an understanding of the contexts and system in which healthcare is provided and the ability to apply this knowledge to improve and optimize health care delivery. Leads/participates in systems improvements.
4. Professional- Interacts with patients and families in a respectful, courteous and timely fashion using appropriate communication for the patient and situation. Interacts collaboratively with coworkers, other team members and staff in a respectful, courteous, and timely fashion appropriate to patient care needs and situations. Responds quickly to meet customer needs and resolve problems. Accepts responsibility for outcomes of one?s work. Shares responsibility for overall workload with team members.
5. Quality/Research- Engages in daily continuous quality improvement by identifying and implementing processes for improvement. Consults with management in assessment, problem-solving, decision-making, and evaluating clinical/system issues and models of care. Leads interdisciplinary teams to provide integrated delivery of patient care services. Initiates and revises protocol(s) or guideline(s) to reflect evidence-based changes in care management Works to influence policy-making bodies to improve patient care. Develops new clinical programs or services within the department/unit/clinic to improve patient care.

Recruiter: Cody Hair, cody.hair@unchealth.unc.edu

● Effective leadership skills. Strong interpersonal skills.
● Ability to work independently and collaboratively.
● Demonstrated written and verbal communication and strong analytical skills.
● Effective interaction to ensure the successful care of patients in the clinical setting.
● Documentation in the medical record to substantiate accurate billing.

Position Overview

The Cardiac ICU Advanced Practice Provider (APP)—Nurse Practitioner (NP) or Physician Assistant (PA)—will be an integral member of a high-acuity multidisciplinary team managing critically ill patients with advanced cardiac conditions. This role provides comprehensive care for patients with cardiogenic shock, advanced heart failure, post–myocardial infarction complications, and those requiring temporary mechanical circulatory support, including ECMO, Impella, and IABP. The APP will work closely with cardiology, cardiac surgery, critical care, residents, and ancillary services while contributing to education, coordination, quality improvement, protocol development, and research activities related to cardiac critical care.

Location & Setting:

• Primary location(s): Charlotte, NC – CMC
• Care setting: Inpatient Cardiac Intensive Care Unit / high-acuity cardiac critical care environment
• Service area / coverage: Critically ill cardiac patients with advanced cardiac conditions, including cardiogenic shock, advanced heart failure, post-MI complications, and temporary mechanical circulatory support needs

Schedule & Call Expectations:

• Schedule (days, shifts): 13-hour shifts, rotating holiday/weekend coverage
• No call requirements

Scope of Practice/What You’ll Do:

Provide direct patient management, advanced assessment, diagnosis, treatment planning, monitoring, care coordination, and collaboration within a fast-paced, high-acuity Cardiac ICU.

• Core responsibilities: Perform comprehensive assessment, diagnosis, and management of critically ill cardiac patients; manage acute decompensated heart failure, cardiogenic shock, post-MI complications, vasoactive medications, inotropes, and mechanical support devices; coordinate transitions between levels of care, including step-down and transfer to tertiary facilities when necessary
• Patient population: Critically ill cardiac patients with advanced cardiac conditions, including cardiogenic shock, advanced heart failure, post–myocardial infarction complications, and patients requiring temporary mechanical circulatory support
• Procedures / clinical skills: Manage temporary mechanical circulatory support devices, including ECMO, Impella, IABP, and ventricular assist devices under established protocols; support advanced hemodynamic monitoring, titration, and weaning of vasoactive medications, inotropes, and mechanical support devices
• Autonomy vs collaboration: Direct patient management role with close collaboration alongside attending cardiologists, intensivists, cardiac surgeons, residents, nursing, pharmacy, physical therapy, nutrition, and other ancillary team members

Team & Support Structure

• Team composition: Multidisciplinary cardiac critical care team including cardiology, cardiac surgery, critical care, residents rotating through the Cardiac ICU, nursing staff, pharmacists, physical therapists, nutritionists, and other ancillary services
• Collaboration model: Works closely with attending cardiologists, intensivists, cardiac surgeons, and the broader care team to optimize patient outcomes in a high-acuity ICU setting

Our GI Surgical Oncology Section uses the latest surgical techniques and technologies to obtain the best possible results. Hematology is searching for an APP to assist with the hospitalized hematology consult patient service. The APP will round daily on the hematology consult service team which will improve communication with consulting services and patients. The utilization of an APP as part of the consult team within the Division of Hematology would increase the accessibility of care in the hospitalized setting. The current schedule of physicians and fellows in Hematology make daily visits with all consult patients extremely challenging. Incorporating an APP as part of the consult team who understands the nuances of hematology would increase patient and consulting team satisfaction. The APP would be responsible for seeing several new patients each day as well as having a group of follow-up patients seen each day. • Share pager coverage with the fellow to provide coverage for medication approvals, follow-up on laboratory results, etc

Experience

• 1+ years of APP experience strongly preferred. Having some background in hematology would also be preferred but not necessary.

• Monday-Friday, 8 am to 5 pm with possibility of administrative time off every week (1/2 day per week to catch up on coordination of outpatient follow ups for example)
• Open to 4 day inpatient week coverage

Job Location

Duke University Hospital

Job Summary

We are seeking an Advanced Practice Provider (Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant) for the Adult Electrophysiology (EP) unit at Duke University Hospital. The APP will work in collaboration with attending physicians and the EP care team to provide direct care to cardiology patients, with a primary focus on EP patients in the Cardiovascular Short Stay pre-procedural and post-procedural areas. The APP performs physical examinations, obtains procedural consent, collects and documents clinical data, conducts approved diagnostic and therapeutic procedures, orders and schedules laboratory studies and professional consultations, prescribes appropriate interventions and medications, and contributes to excellence in patient care, research, teaching, and leadership.

Primary hours are four 10-hour shifts per week for a 40-hour work week. Hours and days may vary based on service needs and may be adjusted by Heart Center Leadership in consultation with clinical service line leadership.

Job Duties & Responsibilities

• Evaluate new, consult, and established cardiovascular patients ages 16 years and older during the pre-procedural, post-procedural, and/or perioperative phases of care; diagnose, treat, and manage common conditions in the cardiovascular patient population.
• Obtain and document patient histories and physical examinations; prepare patient workups, progress notes, and summaries; document pertinent positive and negative findings; obtain relevant psychosocial history; and develop therapeutic relationships with patients and families.
• Order and schedule laboratory studies and diagnostic procedures; explain the necessity, preparation, nature, and anticipated effects of scheduled diagnostic and therapeutic procedures.
• Obtain informed consent for appropriate procedures and conscious sedation for assigned patients, and discharge procedural patients as directed by the attending physician, including discharge summaries, patient education, and discharge orders.
• Assess patients for changes in clinical status and initiate appropriate interventions, including emergency stabilization and preparation for transfer to the Emergency Department, Operating Room, or inpatient setting when needed.
• Collaborate closely with the EP Lab Charge Nurse, Outpatient Discharge (EOD) Service, inpatient rounding teams, lab fellows, physicians, and other members of the interdisciplinary team to allocate workload and meet daily clinical and operational needs.
• Perform or assist with approved procedures after competency validation, which may include venous and arterial blood sampling, peripheral IV insertion, venous/PICC line removal, urinary catheterization, wound management, urgent/emergent defibrillation or cardioversion, tilt testing, implantable loop recorder insertion, sheath removal, temporary permanent pacemaker dressing changes, and pacemaker/ICD interrogation.
• Administer and manage ordered infusion therapy and medications within scope of practice, including IV fluids, anticoagulants, analgesics, antibiotics, antiarrhythmics, antihypertensives, inotropes, electrolytes, blood products, and nutrition therapies.
• Participate in education, training, evidence-based practice, quality improvement, and research activities; support the education of patients, families, staff, learners, and trainees.

Job Eligibility Requirements

Education

Nurse Practitioners: Work requires completion of an accredited graduate-level Acute Care Nurse Practitioner program.

Physician Assistants: Work requires graduation from a Physician Assistant program accredited by the Accreditation Review Commission on Education for the Physician Assistant (ARC-PA) or its predecessor agencies.

Certification

National certification as an Acute Care NP or certification by the National Commission on Certification of Physician Assistants (NCCPA), as applicable.

BLS and ACLS certification required.

License

Nurse Practitioners: Current licensure as a Registered Nurse in the state of North Carolina and approval to practice as an Acute Care Nurse Practitioner.

Physician Assistants: Current licensure as a Physician Assistant in the state of North Carolina.

Experience

At least one year of experience as an Acute Care NP or PA in cardiology/electrophysiology is strongly preferred.

Job Hours

Full-time salaried position, 40 hours per week; four 10-hour shifts. Hours and days may vary based on service needs.

jobs.description:
Overview

The Gastroenterology outpatient/inpatient care Physician Assistant or Advanced Practice Nurse (APN) assists, monitors, and manages the day-to-day needs of patients as requested by, in conjunction with, and under the supervision of a physician. Performs the duties and responsibilities of a Physician Assistant/Nurse Practitioner according to customary and generally accepted medical standards.

Position is located in Manahawkin, NJ.

Office hours:

M-F 8:30-5:00

No weekends required.

No holidays required.

No on-call requirement.

Very busy GI practice with three GI physicians and three APPs.

Responsibilities

1. Provide medical services under the supervision of a licensed physician, consistent with the PA's education, training and experience. 2. Performs and documents accurate, complete, and relevant history and physical assessments appropriate for the patient's age, gender, and clinical problem. 3. Orders, performs, and interprets laboratory tests and diagnostic studies/procedures in collaboration with physicians and consultants as appropriate. 4. Manages general medical and surgical conditions based on comprehensive knowledge of etiologies, risk factors, pathophysiology, and the indications and contraindications of pharmacologic agents and other treatment modalities. 5. Prescribes medication safely and effectively in accordance with best practices, hospital policy, and NJ regulations, providing patient education as needed. 6. Seeks opportunities to promote Hackensack Meridian Health (HMH) PA practice recognition (locally, nationally, and internationally) through conferences, publications, and presentations. 7. Provides care that is patient- and family-centered, compassionate, and effective for the promotion of health and treatment of disease. 8. Practices as a healthcare provider according to the rules and regulations of the Medical Staff and bylaws as outlined in the delineation of privileges. 9. Applies evidence-based and value-based medicine to systematically analyze and improve patient care practices and outcomes. 10. Evaluates patient/family transition of care planning, considering resource utilization, cost, quality, safety and self-management promotion for chronic conditions. 11. Demonstrates clinical expertise through advanced assessment and procedural skills pertinent to the practice specialty. 12. Translates `best practice' into clinical practice by evaluating current protocols and standards of care. 13. Provides culturally sensitive and educationally appropriate health management education to patients and families. 14. Facilitates consistent, coordinated care and clear communication among all members of the healthcare team through participation in daily interdisciplinary rounds. 15. Serves as an advocate for patients and families, identifying and addressing obstacles to care progression and escalating issues as appropriate. 16. Serves as a clinical resource for the multidisciplinary team by addressing clinical, process, and system improvement opportunities. 17. Participates in organizational and departmental meetings, committees, and workgroups as necessary. 18. Demonstrates the highest level of accountability for professional practice and adheres to ethical principles regarding patient confidentiality, informed consent, and adverse outcomes. 19. Promotes a collaborative work environment supporting the organizational mission, behavior expectations, values, and pillars. 20. Mentors other PAs, precepts students in PA programs and participates in educational programs as a clinical expert. 21. Identifies patient/family educational needs and collaborates to implement appropriate teaching materials. 22. Promotes innovation by integrating new clinical knowledge into practice. 23. Participates in clinical research activities and disseminates findings through practice, education, presentations, and publications. 24. Identifies ethical care issues and coordinates interdisciplinary meetings to resolve them. 25. Comply with HMH and department-specific scope of services, policies and procedures as applicable to role. 26. Adheres to all HMH infection control and safety policies. 27. Other duties and/or projects as assigned. 28. Adheres to HMH Organizational competencies and standards of behavior.

Qualifications

Education, Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required: 1. Successful completion of an approved physician's assistant program, accredited by the AMA Council on Medical Education. 2. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 3. Proficient computer skills that include but are not limited to Microsoft Office and/or Google Suite platforms.

Licenses and Certifications Required: 1. Physician Assistant License. 2. National Commission on Certification of Physician Assistants. 3. BLS AHA Basic Health Care Life Support HCP Certification. 4. AHA Advanced Cardiac Life Support Certification.

Education, Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required: 1. Graduate of an NLN/AACN accredited nursing program. 2. Master's or Doctorate degree from an accredited Nurse Practitioner program. 3. Maintains clinical competencies through continuing education and clinical practice. 4. Experience in a relevant patient care setting (or as regulations dictate). 5. National Provider Identifier (NPI). 6. Prescriptive authority through CDS and DEA registration according to New Jersey state law. 7. Collaborative agreement with physicians on staff. 8. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 9. Proficient computer skills that include but are not limited to Microsoft Office and/or Google Suite platforms. Licenses and Certifications Required: 1. NJ State Professional Registered Nurse License. 2. Advance Practice Nurse License. 3. BLS AHA Basic Health Care Life Support HCP Certification. 4. Board certified by AANP or ANCC. Licenses and Certifications 5. Advanced Cardiac Life Support Certification.

Compensation
Minimum rate of $146,348.80 Annually

We are seeking an experienced Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant to join our Electrophysiology team in a primarily procedure-based role within the Ambulatory Surgery Center. Ideal Candidate

Duke Advanced Practice Highlights:

• The nation’s first Physician Assistant Program was created at Duke in 1965 and is consistently ranked No. 1 in the country.
• The Duke School of Nursing is consistently ranked as one of the top nursing schools and their MSN and DNP programs offers eight advanced practice registered nurse majors and specialty certifications, as well as post master’s certificates and certification alignment programs.
• Commitment to ongoing learning for APPs through annual CME funding and access to high-quality Duke CME offerings including APP Grand Rounds and a professional advancement program. APPs are leaders in multiple arenas within Duke.
• Duke offers APPs opportunities to practice within team based integrative care in a tremendous variety of specialties. APPs are expected to work to top of scope in order to contribute to Duke’s missions which include clinical practice, education, and research.
• Practice locations can include Duke Health’s three hospitals or over 140 primary care and specialty care clinics throughout North Carolina.

Job Location

predominately outpatient position with the opportunity for inpatient work at Duke Raleigh Hospital

Job Summary

The Palliative Care Advanced Practice Provider (APP) provides direct patient care services and performs medical acts under the supervision of the supervisory physician to patients >18 years of age requiring palliative care and symptom management. The APP performs physical exams, collects and documents data, conducts diagnostic and therapeutic procedures, orders and schedules laboratory studies and professional consultations, and prescribes appropriate interventions and medications. The Palliative Care APP contributes to excellence in patient care, research, teaching, and provides leadership in the organization.

Job Duties and Responsibilities

• In collaboration with attending palliative care physicians; diagnose, plan treatment, set priorities and realistic outcomes, and evaluate the effectiveness and cost efficiency of patient care.
• Provide and coordinate clinical care through established protocols and under the supervising physician or back up physician who is either on site or available by pager.
• Assess patients for change in status and institute appropriate interventions. Initiate emergency interventions in an effort to stabilize the patient until physician support arrives.
• Develop patient care pathways, protocols and guidelines for the management of specific problems in conjunction with physicians and other members of the health care team.
• Analyze clinical practice patterns so as to provide the best medical care and to increase effectiveness and efficiency.
• Communicate verbally and in writing all pertinent patient information to supervising MD, nursing staff, patient resource manager, home health agency, hospice agency and other relevant healthcare providers.
• Document in the patients’ medical record all relevant data including but not limited to results of diagnostic tests; laboratory results; patients’ condition and response to therapies/interventions; communications with supervising MD.
• Implement a specific plan of palliative care to alleviate suffering and promote the physical, emotional, psychological, and spiritual comfort of the patient and family.
• Utilize prescriptive privileges only for identified patient population and in accordance with DUH and NC Board of Nursing/NC Medical Board regulations.
• Prescriptive authority for prescribing, ordering, and or administering drugs; including (but not limited to) schedule II, III, IV, and V drugs and necessary medical devices.
• Role model competence in all nurse practitioner / physician assistant advanced skills.

Job Eligibility Requirements

Education

NP: Graduate of accredited MSN or DNP Nurse Practitioner program for adult care

PA: Graduate of ARC accredited Physician Assistant Program, Masters or DSc Degree preferred

Certification:

NP: Any NP certification that treats adults (FNP, ANP, AGNP, AGACNP, etc.)

PA: PA-C

Licensure

NP: Must have current RN licensure issued by NCBON with authorization to practice as NP

PA: Must have license to practice as PA issued by NCMB

Both: Federal and State DEA independent license/prescriptive authority

Experience

2+ years of APP experience is required, experience as an APP, caring for seriously ill patients with psychiatric comorbitilities is strongly preferred

Job Hours

Monday – Friday, 8am - 5pm

Job Summary

We are excited to announce an opportunity for an Advanced Practice Provider to join our Duke Neurological Sleep Clinic, serving both Durham and Raleigh/Cary, North Carolina, with a focus on insomnia care. In this role, you will:

• Collaborate with attending physicians to provide specialized care for patients with insomnia and related sleep disorders.
• Deliver Cognitive Behavioral Therapy for Insomnia (CBTi) and pharmacologic management for insomnia.
• Collect and document patient data accurately.
• Conduct diagnostic and therapeutic procedures.
• Order and schedule laboratory studies and professional consultations.
• Provide direct patient care services to individuals with insomnia and other sleep disorders.

The primary hours for this position are Monday through Friday, during the day shift, with flexibility to meet the needs of our patients.

• Patient Care: Take patient histories, conduct physical examinations, and record data in the patient's record. Write progress notes, prepare patient workups and summaries, noting pertinent positive and negative findings. Obtain psychosocial history relevant to patient care and develop therapeutic relationships with patients, especially those struggling with chronic insomnia.
• Insomnia-Specific Care: Administer and interpret validated sleep assessment tools. Develop and implement individualized CBTi treatment plans. Prescribe and manage medications used to treat insomnia, while monitoring efficacy and side effects.
• Diagnostic Procedures: Order and schedule laboratory studies and diagnostic procedures. Explain the necessity, preparation, nature, and anticipated effects of scheduled diagnostic and therapeutic procedures to the patient.
• Patient Monitoring: Monitor patient progress, report to the supervising physician, and maintain records of each patient's progress. Consult with the supervising physician when a patient's progress does not meet anticipated criteria.
• Therapeutic Procedures: Perform diagnostic and therapeutic procedures to assist the physician in diagnosing sleep disorders and prescribing necessary treatments. Record normal and abnormal data for review by the physician.
• Teaching: Participate in teaching students and residents techniques and procedures unique to insomnia management and behavioral sleep medicine..
• Clinical Trials: Participate in clinical trial subject recruitment, enrollment, and study, particularly those related to insomnia treatment.

Education

• Nurse Practitioners: Work requires completion of an accredited Nurse Practitioner program, with a Master's degree in Nursing.

• BLS required.

• Physician Assistants: Must be licensed in the state of NC, and be certified as a Physician Assistant by the National Commission on Certification of Physician Assistants.
• DEA licensure required.

Experience

• 1+ years of experience treating patients with insomnia preferred.
• Formal training in Cognitive Behavioral Therapy for Insomnia (CBTi) strongly preferred.
• Comfort with prescribing insomnia medications required.
• Experience in sleep medicine or behavioral sleep medicine preferred.

Job Hours

• Monday–Friday, day shift, with flexibility to meet clinic needs.
• Eight 4-hr patient-facing sessions per week.
• Two 4-hr administrative sessions per week.

jobs.description:
MaineHealth Maine Medical Center, Portland, ME, is recruiting for a Physician Assistant (PA) or Acute Care Nurse Practitioner (ACNP) with 3-5 years of cardiovascular experience to work at Maine Medical Center providing coverage for cardiac patients primarily on the floor and in the Intermediate Care Unit (IMC). This is a wonderful opportunity to work in an exciting environment with a broad scope of practice. 3-5 years of critical care experience preferentially in a Cardiac Surgery setting; bachelor's degree required; master's degree preferred; successful completion of accredited Physician Assistant or Nurse Practitioner program; current license issued by the State of Maine or eligible for licensure; current ACLS and BLS certification.

The Palliative Care APP is an integral member of the Palliative Care Interdisciplinary Team of physicians, APPs, nurses, social workers, and chaplains who deliver patient- and family-centered care to individuals of all ages living with serious illnesses. The Palliative Care APP will care for patients in the inpatient setting at Maine Medical Center Portland, ME.

• Embodies and serves as an ambassador for the philosophy of evidence-based care provision following NCP guidelines.

• Provides services in a timely and courteous manner with care and respect for the patient’s individual needs.

• Education: Successful completion of an approved Acute Care Nurse Practitioner or Physician Associate program.
• License/Certifications: Current license and registration to practice as an Advance Practice Registered Nurse or Physician Associate as required in the State of Maine.

• Analytical abilities necessary to obtain medical histories, conduct physical examinations, prepare complex treatment plans, and treat assigned patients with minimal guidance and direction.
• Interpersonal skills and communication skills to engage as a specialist with a variety of personnel (e.g., patients, employees, physicians, and other health care professionals.)
• Knowledge of patient assessment techniques including taking medical histories, performing physicals, evaluating health status, including state of wellness and compliance with care recommendations.
• Skill in case management, time management, problem solving, crisis intervention, multitasking and other organizational matters.

§ Ability to make responsible decisions within scope of practice (ACNP or PA).

• Ability to educate patients, families, and staff in user-friendly manner.
• Strong computer skills with skill in using computerized health information management system.
• Excellent communication, interpersonal and customer service skills with the ability to establish/maintain effective working relationships with patients, clinical staff and the public.
• Ability to maintain confidentiality.

Full-Time | Acute Care Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant

If it’s possible, you will find it at Atrium Health. We invite Nurse Practitioners and Physician Assistants to discover an opportunity to join Atrium Health General Surgery Lincoln in Lincolnton, North Carolina

This full-time opportunity offers a balanced hybrid inpatient and outpatient general surgery role, combining clinic-based patient care with inpatient responsibilities and operating room assistance. The APP will join an established, collaborative team consisting of two physicians and one APP, offering the opportunity to build surgical experience while working alongside physicians with deep experience serving the Lincoln community.

Position Highlights

• Full-time, 1.0 FTE
• Monday-Friday schedule with no nights, weekends, or call
• Hybrid inpatient/outpatient general surgery position
• Typical schedule includes approximately: 3 days of outpatient clinic 2 days of inpatient care/OR assistance
• Outpatient clinic hours are generally 8:00 AM-5:00 PM
• Inpatient/OR days may begin at approximately 7:00 AM
• Assist physicians in the operating room
• Perform appropriate in-office procedures, including port removals
• Collaborative practice environment with two physicians and one APP
• No academic or protected research responsibilities

What You’ll Do

The APP will support the General Surgery team across the continuum of inpatient and outpatient care. Responsibilities will include managing patients in the clinic, supporting hospitalized surgical patients, assisting physicians in the operating room, and performing appropriate office-based procedures.

This position provides a varied workweek for an APP interested in maintaining both clinical and surgical responsibilities rather than working exclusively in an inpatient or outpatient setting.

Ideal Candidate

• Acute Care Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant
• Appropriate board certification/training for the role
• Eligible for or currently holds North Carolina licensure
• Interested in a combination of outpatient general surgery, inpatient care, and operating room responsibilities
• Comfortable learning surgical first-assist responsibilities and office-based procedures
• Collaborative and interested in working closely with an established surgical team
• New graduates will be considered

Why Atrium Health General Surgery Lincoln?

This is an opportunity to join two experienced physicians who have served the community for many years and bring significant clinical experience to the practice. The position offers an APP the ability to develop a well-rounded general surgery skill set through exposure to the clinic, inpatient environment, operating room, and office-based procedures.

Join a Nationally Recognized Neuroscience Program

Atrium Health Carolinas Medical Center (CMC) is seeking a highly motivated Nurse Practitioner (NP) or Physician Assistant (PA) to join our growing Neurosciences Intensive Care Unit (NSICU) team. This is an exceptional opportunity to practice at a leading academic and tertiary referral center, providing advanced neurocritical care to patients with complex neurologic and neurosurgical conditions.

As an APP in the NSICU, you will work alongside expert neurointensivists, neurosurgeons, vascular neurologists, residents, pharmacists, nurses, and rehabilitation specialists to deliver evidence-based care in a high-acuity environment focused on innovation, collaboration, and outstanding patient outcomes.

Why Atrium Health Carolinas Medical Center?

· ANCC Magnet® Designated Hospital, recognizing excellence in nursing practice, patient care, and professional development.

· Home to the George Shinn Comprehensive Stroke Center, designated by The Joint Commission as a Comprehensive Stroke Center, the highest level of stroke certification.

· Recognized among the Top 10% in the Nation for Stroke Care by U.S. News & World Report.

· Recipient of the American Heart Association Get With The Guidelines® Stroke Gold Plus, Target: Stroke Honor Roll Elite Plus, and Advanced Therapy awards for excellence in stroke care and patient outcomes.

· Part of one of the Southeast's largest and most experienced neuroscience and stroke programs, caring for more than 4,000 stroke patients annually.

· Opportunities for professional growth, APP leadership, resident education, quality improvement, research, and protocol development.

Position Highlights

· High-acuity Neurosciences ICU caring for patients with:

o Acute ischemic and hemorrhagic stroke

o Subarachnoid hemorrhage

o Cerebral aneurysms and neurovascular emergencies

o Traumatic brain injury

o Status epilepticus

o Brain tumors and complex neurosurgical conditions

o Spinal cord injury

o Postoperative neurosurgical patients

· Collaborative multidisciplinary practice model

· Exposure to advanced neuromonitoring and neurocritical care technologies

· No call requirements

· 24/7 In-house Intensivist Support

· Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package

Schedule

· Twelve (13hr) Shifts/month; 145 shifts/year

· Rotating weekends and holidays

· Inpatient Neurosciences ICU setting

Responsibilities

· Perform comprehensive assessment, diagnosis, treatment, and management of critically ill neurologic and neurosurgical patients

· Manage patients with acute stroke, intracranial hemorrhage, cerebral edema, seizures, vasospasm, and other neurocritical illnesses

· Monitor and manage external ventricular drains (EVDs), intracranial pressure monitoring, and other advanced neuromonitoring modalities

· Interpret neurologic examinations, imaging studies, laboratory data, and physiologic monitoring to guide treatment decisions

· Collaborate closely with neurointensivists, neurosurgeons, neurologists, residents, nursing staff, therapists, pharmacists, and ancillary services

· Coordinate transitions of care and facilitate patient and family communication

· Participate in quality improvement, research initiatives, education, and protocol development

Qualifications

Required

· Graduate of an accredited Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant program

· Current North Carolina NP or PA license, or eligibility for licensure

· National certification (AGACNP, ACNP, or NCCPA)

· Current BLS and ACLS certification

Preferred

· Two or more years of experience in Neurocritical Care, Neurosciences ICU, Surgical ICU, Trauma ICU, or Critical Care

· Experience managing EVDs, intracranial pressure monitoring, stroke patients, and postoperative neurosurgical patients

· CCRN, SCRN, CNRN, ENLS, or other neurocritical care certifications

· Experience in an academic or teaching hospital environment

Position Overview

The Cardiac ICU Advanced Practice Provider (APP)—Nurse Practitioner (NP) or Physician Assistant (PA)—will be an integral member of a high-acuity multidisciplinary team managing critically ill patients with advanced cardiac conditions. This role provides comprehensive care for patients with cardiogenic shock, advanced heart failure, post–myocardial infarction complications, and those requiring temporary mechanical circulatory support, including ECMO, Impella, and IABP. The APP will work closely with cardiology, cardiac surgery, critical care, residents, and ancillary services while contributing to education, coordination, quality improvement, protocol development, and research activities related to cardiac critical care.

*Sign-On Bonus Eligible*

Location & Setting:

• Primary location(s): Charlotte, NC – CMC
• Care setting: Inpatient Cardiac Intensive Care Unit / high-acuity cardiac critical care environment
• Service area / coverage: Critically ill cardiac patients with advanced cardiac conditions, including cardiogenic shock, advanced heart failure, post-MI complications, and temporary mechanical circulatory support needs

Schedule & Call Expectations:

• Schedule (days, shifts): Varies, rotating weekends, 12 13hr shifts/month
• No call requirements

Scope of Practice/What You’ll Do:

Provide direct patient management, advanced assessment, diagnosis, treatment planning, monitoring, care coordination, and collaboration within a fast-paced, high-acuity Cardiac ICU.

• Core responsibilities: Perform comprehensive assessment, diagnosis, and management of critically ill cardiac patients; manage acute decompensated heart failure, cardiogenic shock, post-MI complications, vasoactive medications, inotropes, and mechanical support devices; coordinate transitions between levels of care, including step-down and transfer to tertiary facilities when necessary
• Patient population: Critically ill cardiac patients with advanced cardiac conditions, including cardiogenic shock, advanced heart failure, post–myocardial infarction complications, and patients requiring temporary mechanical circulatory support
• Procedures / clinical skills: Manage temporary mechanical circulatory support devices, including ECMO, Impella, IABP, and ventricular assist devices under established protocols; support advanced hemodynamic monitoring, titration, and weaning of vasoactive medications, inotropes, and mechanical support devices
• Autonomy vs collaboration: Direct patient management role with close collaboration alongside attending cardiologists, intensivists, cardiac surgeons, residents, nursing, pharmacy, physical therapy, nutrition, and other ancillary team members

Team & Support Structure

• Team composition: Multidisciplinary cardiac critical care team including cardiology, cardiac surgery, critical care, residents rotating through the Cardiac ICU, nursing staff, pharmacists, physical therapists, nutritionists, and other ancillary services
• Collaboration model: Works closely with attending cardiologists, intensivists, cardiac surgeons, and the broader care team to optimize patient outcomes in a high-acuity ICU setting
• Onboarding/training support: Opportunity to participate in resident education, ongoing professional development, advanced procedure training, protocol development, and research activities related to cardiac critical care

Why This Role / Differentiators

• Unique aspects of the role: High-acuity cardiac ICU role focused on advanced heart failure, cardiogenic shock, post-MI complications, and temporary mechanical circulatory support including ECMO, Impella, and IABP
• Program strengths / growth opportunities: Work at a leading cardiac critical care center with one of the region’s highest volumes of mechanical circulatory support and access to advanced procedure training and professional development
• Academic/research opportunities: Participate in quality improvement initiatives, protocol development, research activities, and education/coordination with residents rotating through the Cardiac ICU
• Culture / community / leadership strengths: Collaborate with renowned cardiologists, cardiac surgeons, intensivists, and a broad interdisciplinary team in a cutting-edge cardiac critical care environment

Qualifications

• Minimum Education and Experience Required: Master’s degree in Nursing (MSN) or Physician Assistant Studies (MPAS) required; active, unrestricted NP or PA license in NC; national certification required, including ACNP, AGACNP, or NCCPA certification; current BLS and ACLS certification
• Preferred: 2–3 years of experience in cardiac critical care, CVICU, or related specialty preferred; critical care or cardiac certification such as CCRN, CSC, or equivalent preferred; proficiency with ECMO, Impella, IABP, and advanced hemodynamic monitoring strongly desired; prior experience in academic or teaching hospital settings is a plus
• Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Required: Advanced clinical assessment and critical thinking skills; strong proficiency in hemodynamic interpretation and mechanical support management; effective interdisciplinary communication and teamwork; commitment to evidence-based practice and continuous learning; ability to work in a fast-paced, high-acuity environment with precision and collaboration
• Physical Requirements and Working Conditions: Fast-paced, high-acuity inpatient Cardiac ICU environment caring for critically ill patients; additional physical requirements should be confirmed against Workday standard requirements

The Duke Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology is seeking an Advanced Practice Provider (APP) to join its team of experienced Complex Menopause providers. The APP will deliver evidence-based care, patient education, and counseling that helps patients navigate midlife health concerns. The team includes generalist OB/GYN physicians with Menopause Society certification who will provide mentorship and clinical oversight.

The schedule is variable and may require flexibility, including early-evening and weekend hours to support patient and clinician scheduling needs.

Primary responsibilities

Provide evaluation, management, education, counseling, and treatment for patients with common and complex menopause-related concerns, including:

• Medical management of menopausal health concerns, including menopausal hormone therapy
• Symptomatic perimenopause, including hormonal contraception, IUD use, and cyclic progestogen therapy
• Menopausal and perimenopausal symptom management for patients with hereditary breast and ovarian cancer risk, high-risk cancer patients, and cancer survivors, using hormonal and non-hormonal approaches as appropriate. Patient population may include natural, premature, early, surgical, and radiation-induced menopause
• Menopausal and perimenopausal symptom management in patients with higher-risk conditions, including tobacco use, clotting disorders, cardiovascular disease, valvular disease, liver disorders, and transplant history
• Assessment of abnormal and postmenopausal bleeding
• Menopause-related cognitive and mood changes
• Genitourinary syndrome of menopause
• Midlife vulvar dermatoses and vulvovaginitis
• Midlife weight management
• Sexual health and sexual dysfunction, including desire, arousal, orgasm, genitourinary, and pelvic floor concerns, and related treatment options

Gynecological Care

Based on menopause patient volume, the APP may provide in-person routine gynecologic care and treatment for common concerns including:

• Family planning and reproductive life-planning counseling
• Routine screening examinations and cervical cancer screening
• Referrals for age- and risk-appropriate screening, including mammography, bone density testing, and colorectal cancer screening
• Screening and treatment for sexually transmitted infections
• Evaluation of breast changes or masses
• Evaluation of pelvic or abdominal pain
• Routine postoperative follow-up and problem visits
• Treatment of vulvar cysts and abscesses

Responsibilities may also include in-person assessment and treatment opportunities such as:

• IUD placement and removal
• Endometrial biopsy
• Vulvar biopsy
• Other in-person gynecologic assessments and treatments within the APP’s scope, credentials, and privileges
